info.title: Invify + Quasar Institution Registry & Provider Routing API
info.description: Canonical service-specific contract governing multi-institution governance, institutional code onboarding, and deterministic provider routing across Invify and Quasar (Contract candidate 1.6.0).

get.description: Public / pre-authenticated lookup for tablet and mobile onboarding. Returns safe institutional metadata, supported services, allowed business modes, and KYC verification status. Does not return API secrets or internal routing rules.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Normalized institutional code entered by user

200.description: Code successfully resolved to an active, accredited institution

404.description: Code is not registered, expired, or revoked

422.description: Institution is registered but KYC or regulatory approval is pending or suspended

post.description: Authoritative policy resolver for Quasar checkout and card-not-present payments (PaymentService.initializePaystackCheckout / RoutingService.evaluateChain). Returns eligible Quasar checkout PSP ('paystack' | 'flutterwave') or null when unrouted.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Distributed correlation ID across Invify and Quasar

parameters.name: X-Invify-Key-Id
parameters.description: Key ID of the shared HMAC secret used for signature verification

parameters.name: X-Signature-Timestamp
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of request generation

parameters.name: X-Signature-Nonce
parameters.description: Unique cryptographic nonce for replay protection

X-Invify-Routing-Signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex over X-Signature-Timestamp + '.' + X-Signature-Nonce + '.' + the exact raw response body. The client verifies this before parsing the body as a policy result.

X-Invify-Key-Id.description: Key id that signed this response. An unknown or revoked id is rejected. The body is then not a routing decision.

X-Signature-Timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of this response. Absolute skew above 300 seconds is rejected.

X-Signature-Nonce.description: Nonce unique to this response. Reuse within 10 minutes is rejected.

post.summary: Propose or Apply Tenant Service Provider Override
post.description: Enables a tenant to override an institution's default provider, subject to the institution's tenant_override_policy (PERMITTED_FROM_LIST or OPEN). If policy is LOCKED, requests are rejected with 403 Forbidden.

403.description: Institution policy is LOCKED or selected provider is not in permitted list
